title: Sweat cools the skin when the body is too hot
summary: OpenStax says sweat cools the body surface when a person overheats.
body: OpenStax says sweat glands let the skin surface cool when the body gets overheated. Sweat also helps excrete small amounts of metabolic waste. Temperature control further uses widening or narrowing of heat-carrying vessels in the skin. This card is the cooling job of sweat. It is not a rule about how much water to drink, and it does not describe heat illness.

sources.title: 5.2 and 5.3, chapter review
sources.author: OpenStax
sources.note: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology, first edition, web view, CC BY 4.0. Paraphrase: sweat cools the body surface when overheated; vessel dilation and constriction also take part in thermoregulation.
